engineApi.name: support
engineApi.description: {ok, reason:''|'insecure'|'ios'|'other'} from motorSupport(); drives the banner and connect refusal.

engineApi.name: connected / deviceName
engineApi.description: Link state and Motor.device.name for status line and Connect/Disconnect label; arm button disabled when !connected.

engineApi.name: armed
engineApi.description: Arm state; drives arm button text/class and visibility of deadman row + STOP.

engineApi.name: deadmanRemainingS
engineApi.description: max(0, ceil((20000 - (now - lastHumanTs))/1000)) recomputed on the 1 s deadman tick while armed; null when disarmed.

engineApi.name: recording / frameCount
engineApi.description: Recon recording flag and Motor.frames.length (includes marks) for the record button and 'N frames captured'.

engineApi.name: log
engineApi.description: Ring of â‰¤400 {t, line, cls} lines (cls ''|hdr|ok|warn|err|rx|tx); render as escaped text, autoscroll on append.

engineApi.name: profile
engineApi.description: {service, write, notify, frames:[{label, hex, danger}]} from localStorage 'fishapp.motor.profile'.

engineApi.name: toggleConnect / connect({all})
engineApi.description: Connect flow with requestDevice option ladder; MUST be called synchronously from the click handler (transient user activation). Show-all button calls connect({all:true}).

engineApi.name: disconnect
engineApi.description: Disarm('manual disconnect') then gatt.disconnect, clear chars, log.

engineApi.name: toggleArm / arm / disarm(reason)
engineApi.description: Arm requires connected + confirm, touches human clock, starts 1 s deadman; disarm clears timer and sends NO frame.

engineApi.name: stop(reason)
engineApi.description: Send first /stop/i-labelled frame with force (bypasses arm gate, confirm and rate limit) if connected, then disarm.

engineApi.name: sendFrame(index)
engineApi.description: touch() then sendHex(frame.hex, {danger, label}); the only gesture path that feeds the deadman besides arm.

engineApi.name: addFrame
engineApi.description: prompt label, prompt hex (validated by motorParseHex), confirm 'Can this command MOVE THE BOAT?' -> danger flag; save; toast 'Command saved'.

engineApi.name: saveProfile({service, write, notify})
engineApi.description: trim().toLowerCase() and persist; toast 'Profile saved â€” reconnect to pick it up'.

engineApi.name: recordToggle / markEvent / exportSession / copyLog
engineApi.description: Recon tools: start resets frames and timestamps log; mark prompts and inserts {t,ts,mark}; export downloads JSON; copy writes log text to clipboard.

engineApi.name: onPanelOpen
engineApi.description: On hidden->visible only: repaint, re-seed UUID inputs from storage, run browser-check probe (appends to log). Never re-arms.

engineApi.name: toast / linkLostWhileArmed / deadmanExpired / disarmed(reason)
engineApi.description: Engine notifications for the shared toast bus and any indicators; speak('Motor link lost. Use the foot pedal.') is intended but currently dead (no global speak).

engineApi.name: helmParseTemplate / helmRender / helmToHex / helmInferFields / helmSolveChecksum / HelmSim
engineApi.description: Pure frame-template, inference, checksum-solver and simulator library; no UI or callers today; port verbatim with vitest vectors.

engineApi.name: helmTxSend(hex, opts, coalesceKey)
engineApi.description: Rate-limited (bucket cap 8, 5/s) last-value-wins sender over motorSendHex; force bypasses everything. Unwired today.

engineApi.name: apCompute(ll, fixAgeMs, coarse, dt)
engineApi.description: Single ILOS autopilot step returning {trackBrg, xte, authoritative, want, commanded, deadbanded}; mutates AP.yInt/AP.note; no tick loop exists. Unwired today.
